figures.caption: Fig. 1. Firing patterns for DC input. Dimensionless voltages and currents against time steps in ms. All patterns were automatically generated with the optimization framework from the AdEx model.

Fig. 5. Spike discharge intervals against time steps, both in ms, corresponding to firing patterns with DC input. All patterns were automatically generated with the optimization framework from the AdEx model.
